svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: HPC batch processing with AWS Batch subtitle: New input in Amazon S3 starts a workflow that runs AWS Batch jobs on Spot capacity over Amazon FSx for Lustre direction: down legend: solid: Data and control dashed: Job logs groups: cloud: { type: aws:cloud } region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: cloud } control: { type: zone, label: Workflow, in: region } vpc: { type: aws:vpc, in: region } compute: { type: aws:spot-fleet, label: AWS Batch compute environment, in: vpc } nodes: users: { icon: aws:users, label: Researchers } input: { icon: aws:s3-bucket, label: Input and results, note: Amazon S3 bucket, in: region } events: { icon: aws:eventbridge-rule, label: Object created rule, note: Amazon EventBridge, in: control } workflow: { icon: aws:step-functions, label: AWS Step Functions, note: Run workflow, in: control } batch: { icon: aws:batch, label: AWS Batch, note: Job queue, in: control } fsx: { icon: aws:fsx-lustre, label: Amazon FSx for Lustre, note: Scratch file system mounted by jobs, in: vpc } spot-1: { icon: aws:ec2-spot-instance, label: Spot Instance, note: Amazon EC2, in: compute } spot-2: { icon: aws:ec2-spot-instance, label: Spot Instance, note: Amazon EC2, in: compute } logs: { icon: aws:cloudwatch, label: Amazon CloudWatch, note: Job logs, in: region } edges: - users -> input: { label: upload } - input -> events: { label: object created } # constraint: false keeps the workflow steps side by side in one row. - { from: events, to: workflow, constraint: false } - { from: workflow, to: batch, constraint: false } - batch -> compute: { label: run jobs } # FSx for Lustre imports from and exports to the bucket; the jobs mount the file system. - { from: input, to: fsx, arrow: start, label: import and export } - { from: fsx, to: compute, arrow: start, constraint: false } - batch --> logs: job logs

svg.title: HPC batch processing with AWS Batch
svg.desc: HPC batch processing with AWS Batch. 9 components in 5 groups. Connections: Researchers to Input and results (upload); Input and results to Object created rule (object created); Object created rule to AWS Step Functions; AWS Step Functions to AWS Batch; AWS Batch to AWS Batch compute environment (run jobs); Input and results to Amazon FSx for Lustre (import and export); Amazon FSx for Lustre to AWS Batch compute environment; AWS Batch to Amazon CloudWatch (job logs).

text.tspan: HPC BATCH PROCESSING WITH AWS BATCH
New input in Amazon S3 starts a workflow that runs AWS Batch jobs on Spot capacity over Amazon FSx for Lustre
